# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5277

# Review — PAN-5277
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the "Retry batch assembly" action was dropped; after a failed assembly no control can rebuild the batch, but this PR's docs say Rebuild works there

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5277-review-d0ce9efa
- Manifest: /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5277/.pan/review/agent-pan-5277-review-d0ce9efa/context.json
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5277 / /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck/workspaces/feature-pan-5277
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5300
- HEAD reviewed: d0ce9efab4488b01970e4dd7565d6f94d617b769
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge base 3ad7eb45059 (origin/main merged in at HEAD); no prior review cycle
- Spec: `.pan/drafts/pan-4753.md` WI-3, WI-7, WI-10, WI-11 (steps 2-3), WI-12, WI-13; AC-3, AC-7, AC-10..AC-13. The manifest carried no acceptance criteria, so they come from the PRD's section 8.

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] An existing recovery action was lost: no control can retry a failed batch assembly — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/merge-train/train/BatchCard.tsx:312`
- Severity: ! MUST
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope. This PR deletes `MergeTrainView.tsx` (WI-12 step 4) and does not port the action, although WI-10 says to port "the confirm-gated actions" first.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: At base, `MergeTrainView.tsx:638-683` rendered a confirm-gated **Retry batch assembly** button (`merge-train-retry-assembly-<project>`, PAN-4598) when the newest generation was `failed` and there was no testable batch. `MergeTrainView.test.tsx:276-315` tested it. Both files are deleted. The only remaining caller of `POST /api/merge-train/assemble` is `BatchCard`'s **Rebuild**, and that button renders only when `gen.status === 'ready'` (BatchCard.tsx:304 and 312). `pickHeroBatch` (ProjectTrainCard.tsx:40-44) never picks a `failed` batch, so a failed assembly shows only as an `OlderBatchRow` ("Older batch … · assembly failed"). Expanded, it is a BatchCard with no actions (`promotable` false, `status !== 'ready'`, no ship). `git grep "merge-train/assemble"` finds no CLI or other UI caller.
- Expected / observed / impact: Expected: after a failed assembly, the operator can retry from the train card, as before. Observed: there is no button anywhere. After three consecutive failures, the reconciler stops retrying for `FAILED_STREAK_WINDOW_MS` (6 h, `uat-reconciler.ts:71`). So a hold project such as Mind Your Now gets no batch for up to 6 hours, and the dashboard offers no recovery. The docs added by this PR state the opposite: `features/merge-batches.mdx:115-121` ("**Rebuild** assembles a fresh batch at once, including after a failed assembly … **Rebuild** tries again at once") and `docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md:225-226` ("including after a failed assembly"). The old doc text it replaced named **Retry batch assembly**.
- Evidence: static trace (base `git show 3ad7eb45059:…/MergeTrainView.tsx` 630-683, `mergeTrainCopy.ts:69 canRetryAssembly`; head `BatchCard.tsx:304-316`, `ProjectTrainCard.tsx:40-44, 119-126`); repo-wide `git grep`. I did not run the scenario in a browser.
- Fix: Restore the action. One option: show **Rebuild** (with the same confirm) on a project card whose newest generation is `failed` and has no `ready`/`assembling` batch, gated by the old `canRetryAssembly` rule (`mergeTrainCopy.ts:69`, still exported). Another option: render Rebuild on a `failed` BatchCard. Port the deleted retry-assembly test cases (old test lines 276-315) into `ProjectTrainCard.test.tsx` or `BatchCard.test.tsx`.

## Non-blocking Findings

1. **~ Merge buttons show on train-off cards, and every click returns 409** (`TrainCarRow.tsx:100-106`, `BatchCard.tsx:269-285`; implementation defect, in_pr_scope). `POST /api/merge-train/merge-next` refuses with 409 "merge-train is disabled for project X" whenever `isMergeTrainEnabledForProject` is false (`routes/merge-train.ts:254-257`). The master switch off (D4) gives the same refusal on every project. The old view rendered no rows for a disabled project, so no working action was lost. Now `ready`/`held` cars and live-batch chips offer **Merge** / **Merge alone…** that cannot succeed. The toast names the cause. Fix: hide or disable these actions when `!project.enabled`, or let merge-next accept an explicit `issueId` while the train is off. `docs/MERGE-TRAIN.md` ("Manual merges stay allowed") and `features/merge-batches.mdx` describe the Merge button with no train-off caveat.
2. **~ The train-off banner is wrong for hold projects** (`trainCopy.ts:42-43`). "Each ready PR merges on its own after the cooldown" holds for auto projects under D4. In a hold project, held features route `batch` even with the train off (R1 rule 1), and batching does not run then, so nothing merges on its own. Use mode-aware copy. (The PRD's literal text, "Nothing merges automatically", was correctly not used because D4 amended it.)
3. **~ A stale journal failure outranks the cooldown** (`merge-train-board.ts:132-143, 287-303`; specification defect). `journalFailure` has no head check, and `failed` outranks `cooldown`. A row re-armed as `pending` after an earlier `merge.failed` entry, with no later `merge.attempted`, shows "Last merge failed" with **Retry** instead of the countdown with **Cancel**. This follows PRD WI-7 step 3.2 as written. The spec should limit the journal leg to a failure at the current head, or rank a `pending` row above it.
4. **~ "Ready" covers PRs that are not ready yet** (`merge-train-board.ts:302-308`; specification gap). "Otherwise → ready" includes approved PRs whose checks are still pending (only `red` is a blocker). Their **Merge** button returns 409 "not in the ready set". This follows the PRD precedence; consider a checks-pending state or a Merge gated on `inReadySet`.
5. **~ The project page's "Merge train ↓" link has no target in the sparse layout** (`ProjectSettingsDisclosure.tsx:549-556`, `Stage/ProjectHome.tsx:249`). When a project has no features, `ProjectHome` renders `ProjectSettingsDisclosure` without `ProjectOverview`, so no `#merge-train` element exists and the link does nothing. Before, it navigated to Awaiting Merge. Hide the link when the target is absent, or fall back to Awaiting Merge.
6. **~ Synchronous journal reads on the board route** (`merge-train-board.ts:248, 280, 594-598`; performance, bounded). `readPipelineJournal` uses `readFileSync`. A board build reads each open feature PR's journal up to twice, plus up to 20 merged rows in `recentMergesForProject`. The files are small, and the 5 s board cache plus the 15 s client poll keep this to a few dozen small reads per build. Advisory; an async read or a per-build memo would remove it.
7. **? `strikeFactsCache` never evicts** (`merge-train-board.ts:484`). It is keyed by `issueId|head` and grows by one entry per strike head. Strikes are few, so this is negligible unless strike volume grows.
8. **? The trim overwrites the original reason** (`uat-generation-engine.ts:481-482`). A `superseded` batch trimmed beyond the newest 3 has its "replaced by …" reason replaced with "trimmed: older than the newest 3 batches". The new reason is accurate; the earlier one is lost.
9. **Unreachable but gated paths (advisory, not stub UI).** The AutoMergeToggle write path is unreachable because `POLICY_WRITE_ROUTE_AVAILABLE = false` (`merge-train-board.ts:111`) and `writable` defaults to false; the read-only spans render, and a 404/501 also falls back to read-only. The BatchCard `stack-unhealthy` override form is unreachable until WI-9's server change ships, because the server never returns that reason today. Both are correctly gated for this slice and wait on WI-8 and WI-9.
10. **`readyAt` deviates from the spec** (`merge-train-board.ts:326`). The PRD names the head-approval time (`approvedAtHeadAt`). The implementation uses the ready-since clock (newest check completion), which avoided touching `pr-facts.ts` (983 lines). It is reasonable and consistent with the batch window, but it is a spec deviation worth recording.

Stub-UI scanner dispositions (all mitigated):
- `BatchCard.tsx:84` `confirming`: set at lines 99, 308, 337.
- `BatchCard.tsx:87` `shipOpen`: set at lines 134, 318, 368.
- `BatchCard.tsx:89` `overrideOpen`: set at lines 101, 337, 343.
- `MergeTrain.tsx:49`: `readStoredFilter` returns null by design when nothing is stored.
- `OlderBatchRow.tsx:12` `open`: toggled by the show/hide buttons.
- `RecentMergesStrip.tsx:18` `open`: toggled by its button.
- `StrikeLane.tsx:44` `expanded` (StrikeRow): toggled by the row button.
- `TrainCarRow.tsx:50` `expanded`: toggled by the row button.

## Coverage

**Changed-file ledger (90 files)**
- Server board / read model: `merge-train-board.ts`, `merge-train-board-types.ts`, `recent-merges.ts`, `merged-issue-ids.ts` — reviewed. Precedence, candidates, strikes, window, NFR-7 error card, cache, and default wiring are traced. The types match the frontend `boardTypes.ts` (diffed).
- Routes: `merge-train-lanes.ts` (board route, 404 on an unknown project) — reviewed. `internal-pipeline-notify.ts` imports `readJsonBody` from the leaf `misc/shared.js` to break a cycle — reviewed, no behavior change.
- WI-3 writers: `uat-generation-engine.ts`, `uat-polyrepo-engine.ts`, `uat-promote.ts`, `uat-reconciler.ts`, `batch-auto-promote.ts`, `uat-train.ts` (wiring and payload), `merge-sync-uat.ts`, `merge-types.ts`, `infra.ts` (top-up) — reviewed. Every `superseded`/`invalidated` write in `src/lib/cloister` and `src/dashboard` carries `statusReason`.
- Blockers / threads: `merge-blocker-types.ts`, `merge-blockers.ts` (re-export; the 3-type payload is unchanged), `unresolved-threads.ts` (failure → empty map, cached) — reviewed.
- Listing: `pr-listing.ts` (`mergeCommit` in the closed fields), `derived-issue-state.ts` (GitLab row fields) — reviewed.
- Frontend `train/`: `MergeTrain`, `ProjectTrainCard`, `BatchCard`, `OlderBatchRow`, `TrainCarRow`, `CarStatusPill`, `MergeStepTracker`, `BlockerList`, `StrikeLane`, `RecentMergesStrip`, `trainCopy`, `boardTypes`, `useMergeTrainBoard` — reviewed.
- `AutoMergeToggle.tsx` — reviewed (gated editable path; read-only by default).
- Placements: `FlywheelPage.tsx`, `FlywheelMergeTrainRail.tsx`, `FlywheelHeadlineStrip.tsx`, `ProjectOverview.tsx`, `ProjectSettingsDisclosure.tsx`, `MergeTrainSection.tsx`, `MergePolicySection.tsx` (11 px) — reviewed.
- `mergeTrainApi.ts` (header comment only) — reviewed.
- Deleted: `MergeTrainView.tsx`, `SectionIntroLine.tsx`, `FlywheelUatBatchesCard.tsx`, `PendingAutoMergesCard.tsx` and their tests — reviewed against the baseline for lost actions (finding: the retry-assembly blocker).
- Tests: all new and changed test files are reviewed for intent. `scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt` lists every new frontend test and drops the deleted one. `tests/e2e/merge-train.spec.ts` now targets the board.
- No-loss: `no-loss-matrix.ts` (board row; merge-next text per WI-13), `tests/unit/flywheel/no-loss.test.ts` (views moved) — reviewed.
- Docs: `docs/MERGE-TRAIN.md`, `docs/MERGE-WORKFLOW.md`, `docs/FLYWHEEL.md`, `docs/WORKSPACES-AND-PROJECTS.md`, `features/merge-batches.mdx`, `CLAUDE.md`, `changelog.d/pan-5277.md` — reviewed (inaccuracies in the blocker and in advisories 1-2).
- `.pan/continues/PAN-5277.xbrief.json` — not applicable (pipeline feedback record).

**Four dimensions**
- Correctness: reviewed. One blocker (lost action); advisories 1-4 and 8.
- Security: no new trust boundary. The board route is a read behind the dashboard's existing auth. The `owner` and `name` GraphQL arguments go through `-f` parameters, not string interpolation. Every mutation reuses an existing route and `dashboardMutationJsonHeaders`. No finding.
- Performance: the board is cached 5 s, polled every 15 s, and merge runs are polled every 3 s only while something merges. Thread counts cost one GraphQL read per repo per 2 min. Per-candidate facts reads hit the 60 s cache but run one after another (bounded). Advisories 6-7.
- Requirements and UX: see the AC matrix; the blocker and advisories 1, 2 and 5.

**AC-to-evidence matrix**
| AC | Status | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| AC-3 (WI-3) | met | The grep shows `statusReason` on every matched line (5 lines). Focused tests pass: schema-topups, both reconciler suites, uat-train, uat-promote. |

| AC-10 (WI-10) | met for tests and grep; **unmet in substance** for "port the confirm-gated actions" (the blocker) | The `train/__tests__` and `AutoMergeToggle.test.tsx` suites pass. The 9/10 px grep prints nothing. |
| AC-11 (WI-11 steps 2-3) | met | The switch testid exists. The grep for the chip and the two deleted cards prints nothing. `FlywheelPage.test.tsx` passes. |
| AC-12 (WI-12) | met | `MergeTrainView.tsx` is gone, no `MergeTrainView` reference remains, and the three named tests pass. |
| AC-13 (WI-13) | met for the greps; doc accuracy is partly unmet (the blocker, advisories 1 and 2) | `docs/MERGE-TRAIN.md` exists with 8 matching lines. The FLYWHEEL non-goal is removed. "outside the train" appears in both files. `roles/strike.md` names the "bot review". |

- Effect diagnostics: CI `lint-group (effect)` ran `npm run lint:effect-diagnostics` (`scripts/run-lint-group.mjs:16`) and passed on this exact HEAD.
- CI on HEAD d0ce9efa (run 43641869961): build, lint (all four groups), test-e2e, and test-shards 1-3 passed. **test-shard (4/4) failed**: `tests/e2e/issue-tree.spec.ts`, 2 tests ("renders a Herdr-spawned reviewer as the Review row…", "takes its rows from the pane inventory alone"), `expected +0 to be 1`. The same two tests also failed on the previous PR run (head 1a906429, run 43640366581). This PR does not touch that spec. main is red right now for an unrelated typecheck error (`needsYou.ts`, run 43643041992), so I could not compare against main. A local run of `npx vitest run tests/e2e/issue-tree.spec.ts` was terminated (exit 143) before it reported a result, so its cause is **unverified**. It is not one of this review's blockers. Two consecutive PR runs failed it while other branches passed CI at the same time, so the work agent should reproduce it before resubmitting and not assume it is inherited.
